name: phil/error-tracking-bundle
description: Catch your Symfony errors at home: requests, workers, commands and browsers grouped, kept with a retention purge, shown by role, with chat alerts on new issues.

suggest.doctrine/orm: For the tables added to the schema the ORM generates
suggest.easycorp/easyadmin-bundle: To graft the administration pages on the dashboards of an EasyAdmin back office
suggest.monolog/monolog: For the handler that captures the error records
suggest.phil/monitoring-bundle: For the health check of the store of the errors
suggest.phil/notifications-bundle: To send the alerts to recipients or an audience as notifications
suggest.phil/rate-limit-bundle: To count the browsers' reports with a named limiter, beside the others of the application
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: For the Stimulus controller without a build step
suggest.symfony/console: For the capture of the commands' errors and phil:error-tracking:purge
suggest.symfony/messenger: For the capture of the failed messages and the queued alerts
suggest.symfony/rate-limiter: For the throttles of the groups and of the browsers' reports, which the bundle refuses to build without unless they are disabled
suggest.symfony/routing: For the administration pages and the endpoint of the browsers
suggest.symfony/security-core: For the role of the administration pages
suggest.symfony/security-csrf: For the actions of the administration pages
